verdict.rationale: Avalara publishes an official MCP server (developer.avalara.com/mcp-servers.md) exposing AvaTax capabilities like tax calculation, transaction retrieval/creation, nexus lookup, and AI tax-code suggestions, confirmed by direct docs and a probe hit. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration outside Avalara's own docs and details on authentication/setup for connecting third-party agents.
